name: Rueda (Spain)
description: Vertically divided with a red hoist third charged with three yellow castles in a column and a green fly charged with a white eight-spoked wheel.
history: The arms were approved on 16 July 1986 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 4 August 1986. The municipal flag was officially approved on 31 March 2011 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 20 May 2011: of dimensions 2:3, tierced at the hoist, on the green cloth of the fly a wheel of eight spokes in white or silver, and on the red hoist third three yellow castles of three towers, crenellated and pierced blue, placed in pale.

features.role: three castles in pale, each of three towers
